metadata.question: Does the area around (43.244129, -79.198692) apprear greener than (43.263113, -79.069485) in Lake Ontario on February 4, 2021?

data.raw_code: The question is asking about comparing greenness between two locations in Lake Ontario on February 4, 2021. 1. **Search Strategy**: - Collection: Sentinel-2 would be best for vegetation analysis - Date: February 4, 2021 (specific date) - Location: Two points in Lake Ontario - Band: Need NDVI for greenness measurement 2. **Masking Strategy**: - Need to mask clouds since they affect NDVI - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking 3. **Logic**: - Calculate NDVI for both locations - Compare the values - February in Canada means winter conditions - likely low NDVI values - Need to check if data exists and has valid pixels Important considerations: - February in Canada = likely snow/ice, which could affect NDVI - Lake Ontario area = potential cloud cover - Need to handle potential no data due to clouds/winter conditions I'll use Sentinel-2 and calculate NDVI for both points, then compare. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.198692, 43.244129]); const point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.069485, 43.263113]); const date = '2021-02-04'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for NDVI function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(ee.Geometry.Point([-79.1340885, 43.253621])) // Center point .map(maskS2clouds); // Check if collection has data const collSize = collection.size().getInfo(); if (collSize === 0) { console.log(`Images found: ${collSize}`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get single image for the date const image = collection.first(); // Calculate NDVI const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); // Extract NDVI values at both points const ndvi1 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point1, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const ndvi2 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: point2, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); // Get pixel counts to check validity const count1 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point1.buffer(100), scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const count2 = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: point2.buffer(100), scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const [val1, val2, cnt1, cnt2] = await Promise.all([ ndvi1.getInfo(), ndvi2.getInfo(), count1.getInfo(), count2.getInfo() ]); console.log(`Images: ${collSize}, Point1 NDVI: ${val1?.toFixed(3)} (px: ${cnt1}), Point2 NDVI: ${val2?.toFixed(3)} (px: ${cnt2})`); // Check for no valid pixels if ((cnt1 === 0 || cnt2 === 0) || (val1 === null && val2 === null)) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (val1 === null || val2 === null || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare NDVI values - point1 appears greener if NDVI1 > NDVI2 if (val1 > val2) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
